model_description: Learned Horner ensemble with width-9 and width-16 TCN specialists for Tiers 2-3 and separate 99,824-parameter width-independent cellular specialists through Tiers 4-6. Tier 6 executes the original orientation for every row, conditionally executes the commuted orientation for the lowest-margin 40%, and selects the higher learned-logit-margin result. Inputs above the learned 128-bit boundary receive a deterministic zero fallback.
training_description: Candidate 004's frozen Tier-2 through Tier-5 specialists are unchanged. The Tier-6 cellular specialist is the frozen EXP-609 straight-through continuation endpoint; the target-free 40% commutative route was frozen by EXP-641 and confirmed at 486/500 exact on fresh width-128 cases in EXP-642. Checked answers were not used for Candidate 005 integration or selection.
